name: airtable
title: Airtable
setup: OAuth or scoped personal access token. Organization policies can block MCP access.

name: atlassian
title: Atlassian
setup: Requires Atlassian Cloud access and permitted app policies. The v2 endpoint is untested in Cocoa.

name: clickup
title: ClickUp
setup: OAuth with PKCE required; personal API keys are not accepted. All plans supported; rate limits vary.

name: context7
title: Context7
setup: Use an API key via CLI --header-env Authorization=ENV. OAuth uses https://mcp.context7.com/mcp/oauth instead.

name: datadog
title: Datadog
setup: US1 default: change URL for your region. Use a personal/service bearer token via CLI. OAuth is unverified; redirect approval may be required.

name: github
title: GitHub
setup: Use a personal access token via CLI --header-env Authorization=ENV. The documented OAuth app flow needs a client secret, unsupported by Cocoa.

name: intercom
title: Intercom
setup: US default. EU: https://mcp.eu.intercom.com/mcp. AU unsupported. Use OAuth or an API bearer token.

name: linear
title: Linear
setup: Sign in with OAuth, or use an API bearer token via CLI. Read-only alternative: https://mcp.linear.app/mcp/readonly.

name: miro
title: Miro
setup: Authorize the board's team. Public-client OAuth is unverified in Cocoa. Enterprise admins must enable MCP. New team/client consent can replace the old.

name: monday
title: monday.com
setup: Personal API bearer token for personal use/testing. OAuth depends on account MCP access and local-connector/admin policy.

name: notion
title: Notion
setup: Sign in with OAuth and choose the workspace/pages Cocoa may access.

name: paypal
title: PayPal
setup: Live account default. For testing use https://mcp.sandbox.paypal.com/http. Sign in and authorize PayPal.

name: sentry
title: Sentry
setup: OAuth requests write permissions. For organization/project scoping, use https://mcp.sentry.dev/mcp/ORG/PROJECT.

name: stripe
title: Stripe
setup: Use OAuth or an agent API bearer key. Account admins can disable MCP. Ordinary secret keys are being retired.

name: supabase
title: Supabase
setup: Use a personal access token as a CLI bearer header; OAuth is unverified. Unscoped, not read-only: Cocoa does not support project/read-only query parameters.
